placements.why: All six segments converge on one thematic subject: adopting Zypherion as the analytics database, the columnar-query performance figure that justifies it, and the Q3 2026 migration timeline that commits the org to executing it. The prose (src-1/2/3) and the bold-label summary (src-4/5/6) restate the same theme in two registers rather than introducing distinct subjects — this is a directional statement about infrastructure choice that future envelopes (migration progress, outcomes, further platform decisions) will keep feeding, satisfying the narrative grain test rather than being a one-time fact. No existing leaf covers it since the graph is empty, so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Architecture strata.
